findings: Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot validates unique IDs, parent existence, ancestry of context-edit/compaction targets, and pending tool calls.
Likely concern, not a verified failure: pending-call tracking keyed by tool-call ID may behave problematically if IDs are reused while outstanding.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts completeRewind validates anchor identity and label availability and attempts rollback if branch writing fails.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts buildContextMessages uses the canonical session projection and truncates pending-rewind context by instruction entry ID.
Likely concern, not a verified failure: extensions/navigate-tree/handoff.ts validHandoff checks broad field types but does not establish semantic consistency or uniqueness of children and sourceIds.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/descendant-sessions.ts copies transcript bodies unchanged while assigning fresh header IDs and remapped parent links.

Potential concern, not a verified failure: extensions/navigate-tree/handoff-renderer.ts handoffView may use retrospective boundary indices to select a broad entries slice without revalidating graph ancestry.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective.ts validateRanges checks ordered, non-overlapping ranges, safe tool-batch cuts, graph incoming parents, and paired context edits; validateClone checks linkage, reference ancestry, runtime state, and projection equivalence.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-ledger.ts parseLedger checks unique IDs and bidirectional supersession lineage.

Likely display concern, not a verified failure: extensions/navigate-tree/tree-screen.ts archivedTurnOf falls back to the last holder when duplicate branch labels cannot be resolved through summary fromId ancestry, potentially associating an archive row with the wrong holder.
